final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(DISTINCT q.arcref) AS n FROM scanqc AS q JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS total_n FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.fundflux, s.n, CAST(s.n AS REAL) / t.total_n AS ratio FROM step1 AS s JOIN step2 AS t ON t.total_n IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM step3) SELECT s.fundflux, s.n, s.ratio, CAST(s.n AS REAL) / a.avg_n AS normalized_ratio FROM step3 AS s JOIN step4 AS a ON a.avg_n IS NOT NULL
